name: lyftr-monorepo
//: npm workspaces root — one install and one lockfile for web, mobile and packages/*. `overrides` below is root-only and cannot be scoped per workspace, which is why every member has to agree on the React version.
//overrides: Force a single React across the workspace — React Native's Fabric renderer crashes if the app and @lyftr/shared resolve different React copies (even different 19.x minors). react-test-renderer is pinned to the same version because @testing-library/react-native renders through it and npm's `react` override does NOT cascade to react-test-renderer — a mismatched minor throws the 'multiple copies of React' hook error under jest.
//postinstall: patch-package applies patches/*.patch to node_modules after every install, including the one EAS and CI run before a build. The one patch there today is expo-localization: see patches/README.md for what it fixes and when to delete it.
